title: Replace text in a stream using sed
summary: Use sed to find and replace specific words or patterns in text output from another command. This is useful for quickly modifying command output without editing files.

steps.explain: Pipe the output of a command to sed to replace all occurrences of 'apple' with 'mango'. The 'g' flag ensures all matches on each line are replaced.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command whose output you want to modify
